description: This file defines the SplashActivity class for an Android TV application. It creates a splash screen with a fixed delay, then transitions to the MainActivity. The class is responsible for the initial display and navigation logic for the app's entry point.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An Android FragmentActivity that displays a splash screen with no user interaction and transitions to MainActivity after a short delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and schedules the transition to MainActivity after a delay.
